mix: one question from each of ten themes in every pack
difficulty: questions 1–9 are accessible and mixed; only question 10 in each 10-question mission is hard
timer: 25 seconds per question, 3 seconds get-ready countdown, automatic reveal when time is up or every team has answered
hosting: GitHub Pages: game runs in the host browser, teams connect peer-to-peer (PeerJS). Netlify Database variant still supported.
